parts: Golden and white male born on January 1, 2012. Shoulder height: 26,5 cm. Weight: 7,300 Kg.

A dog from the finest American and European bloodlines: Xeralane, Regal and Wenrick. 27 champions in his pedigree over 4 generations, 26 of them American and Canadian. A direct descendant of Xeralane, with 26 of his ancestors bearing the same kennel affix.
He clearly embodies the bloodline and type of Shih Tzu we strive for.
I thank his breeder for entrusting us with this fantastic dog.
Father of our M and L litters.
